newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek broker Delta Securities barred from trade Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Greek broker Delta Securities barred from trade Thursday.

text.p: Athens stock exchange member firm Delta Securities was barred from trading again on Thursday for non-compliance with clearing regulations and was unavailable for comment as its offices were closed, sources from the bourse supervisor's office said.
Delta encountered problems with bourse authorities on Tuesday and had its trading terminals on the floor of the exchange shut down for allegedly failing to comply with settlement regulations.
Its offices were closed with no one picking up the phones and brokers were expressing concern on market repercussions.
Meanwhile the Athens bourse tumbled by 2.19 percent late in the session with the benchmark index at 911.82.
